title: General requirements for loans.
bodyText: A credit union shall make loans and extensions of credit that are consistent with prudent lending practices and in compliance with all applicable federal and state law.
bodyHtml: §412:10-401  General requirements for loans.  A credit union shall make loans and extensions of credit that are consistent with prudent lending practices and in compliance with all applicable federal and state law. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
